body: Adds the 0M pieces needed by ClimaAtmos [#4881](https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaAtmos.jl/pull/4881): a below-cloud evaporation rate for the 0M precipitation flux (evaporate_precipitation, with Evaporation0M parameters) and an updraft precipitation timescale (Microphysics0MParams.precip_updraft, τ = precipitation_timescale_updraft_ratio × precipitation_timescale). Defaults are neutral (ratio 1, evaporation coefficient 0).
title: 0M: updraft precipitation parameters and evaporation of the precipitation flux
